scope: K-quant exact small-batch projections synchronize LDS tile exchanges without invalidating the read-only global cache. FP32 arithmetic, weights, launch geometry, sampler, controller and scalar decoding are unchanged. One implementation; no execution option or new maintained test/tool.

synchronization_contract.inputs: w and x are read-only and restrict-qualified. No global memory communication inside the kernel. Output stores follow the final tile.
steps: Explicit lgkmcnt(0) wait with compiler memory clobber completes prior LDS reads/writes.
Convergent workgroup barrier waits for every wave.
Compiler memory clobber after the barrier prevents memory operations moving across it.
synchronization_contract.compiler_reference: LLVM IntrinsicsAMDGPU.td: amdgcn.s.barrier is NoMem, HasSideEffects and Convergent; the raw intrinsic alone is not a compiler memory fence. SyncKQuantTile is also explicitly convergent.
synchronization_contract.entry_exit_ordering: Kernel/stream dependencies retain their existing HIP ordering; only internal tile synchronization changes.

speed.method: Q4 target/Q4 draft, C1, greedy. Adaptive raw JSON/prose TG300: two timed samples per binary in ABBA order, 32-token raw JSON warmup per binary excluded. Fixed-7 repetition chat TG128: two paired samples per binary in ABBA order. Includes prefill, excludes model loading. All IDs checked against preceding qualified AR references; scalar code unchanged.

fused_contract.note: One shared fused-versus-verification test replaces the older same-format-only function. Two distinct inputs, finite bitwise comparisons, mixed formats, partial row groups, and the full-size Q8/Q6 controls.

unaffected_artifacts.reason: These artifacts contain none of the seven affected packed weight formats, so their own projection kernels are unchanged. Q4 target and Q4 draft are qualified here; prior all-draft upstream operator qualification remains linked.

profile.method: Separate release JSON TG300 Q4/Q4 adaptive profiles. Match every SmallBatchKQuantExactFp32GEMMKernel specialization, grid, block and call count; no affected group omitted. Includes prefill/draft calls using the same kernel. Use unprofiled A/B runs for throughput.

integer_residual.method: Original Q5 weights, three/four signed INT8 activation components with a common power-of-two exponent per16 inputs and base128 residuals. Native mixed-sign DOT4, exact bounded integer accumulation and FP32 reconstruction. Encoding included per projection. Eight actual17408x5120 Q5 tensors, two full-mantissa seeds,768 independent host double decode/dot samples per variant; all full outputs finite and all first-token B1/B8 outputs bit-identical. Six balanced rounds x4 rotations.
integer_residual.decision: Reject: B8 is21.3%/41.2% slower with3/4 parts; B1 is4.4% slower. Four parts are closer to the sampled FP64 reference; three are worse. Changed dot-product rounding was never model-qualified and is not retained.

precomputed_activation_sums.method: Actual Q5 GGUF, batch8 and production geometry. Original vs identical clone vs precomputed exact per-subgroup activation sums. prepared_with_launch includes one preparation kernel per projection. prepared_reused_ceiling excludes preparation to estimate potential reuse/fusion only; not a production speed claim. Two full-mantissa input seeds, every output finite/bit-exact before timing.12balancedroundsx6rotations through16tensors.
precomputed_activation_sums.contract: One thread sums sixteen FP32 activations in the existing left-to-right order. Each projection tile then loads this exact sum; weights, dot products and final reduction order are unchanged.
precomputed_activation_sums.quality: All outputs finite and bit-identical for two full-mantissa seeds across sixteen actual tensors per shape. No production edit or model qualification for the rejected probe.

isa_summary.clone_control: The source clone has identical opcodes/resources; one kernel-argument offset changes from40 to48 because the prototype adds an unused pointer argument. Its speed stays within0.49% of production.

precomputed_activation_sums.decision: Reject: including preparation loses 0.72%, 7.42%, 2.97% on up/down/medium. Even the reuse-only ceiling excluding preparation loses 0.17%, 6.71%, 1.18%. No sums workspace or normalization fusion added.
